paths.description: Homepage and primary video-discovery listing; representative global shell, navigation, consent, age gate and content grid.
British category listing; representative taxonomy/listing template.
A trending video detail; representative playback and rich-entity template.
Signup journey opened through the public signup route, including email form and invalid submission.
Synthetic unknown route; representative HTTP/error recovery state.

findings.summary: The page does not follow the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Dark emulation produced the same always-dark surface and the computed probe reported color-scheme: normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() so browser chrome and authored surfaces follow the user preference.

findings.summary: Animations continue when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the probe found eight running animations, each with a 2000 ms duration.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential animations and auto-advance inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Route and state changes have no transition treatment.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition rules on a multi-route site; navigation uses abrupt document swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful route/state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Persistent chrome does not communicate scroll state.
findings.evidence: The long listing has fixed navigation and no scroll timeline/container-query treatment in the CSS probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a restrained shrinking header or progress/scrollability cue that responds to scroll state.

findings.summary: Consent and age-verification interruptions dominate the entry experience.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots on every representative template show a large consent modal obscuring primary content, with a separate age-verification banner behind it.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate required gating, defer non-essential consent UI, keep reject equally direct, and preserve a readable content-first state.

findings.summary: Modal flows are implemented as custom div dialogs and can stack.
findings.evidence: The signup probe found a DIV dialog while the screenshot shows it stacked behind the consent surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native dialog for modal flows and declarative controls/light-dismiss where appropriate; prevent stacked modal states.

findings.summary: Navigation, promotions and category chrome crowd out content.
findings.evidence: The 360 px screenshot gives most of the viewport to a desktop sidebar, age banner, sale banner and clipped navigation rather than the video grid.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary navigation and promotions on small screens and prioritize the content grid.

findings.summary: The mobile layout renders at desktop width and overflows by 672 px.
findings.evidence: At a 360 px visual viewport, layout evidence reported scrollWidth 1032, clientWidth 360 and horizontalOverflowPx 672.
findings.suggestedFix: Use an intrinsic mobile layout, collapse the sidebar, and ensure components size to the visual viewport without horizontal overflow.

findings.summary: Reusable components do not adapt at component level.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no container queries, while the sidebar and cards remain desktop-sized in the 360 px capture.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type to reusable regions and adapt card/navigation internals with size-aware container queries.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch target support are inadequate.
findings.evidence: The focused first control computed outline-style none; Lighthouse also failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a strong :focus-visible treatment and increase/space touch targets to at least the applicable WCAG target-size expectation.

findings.summary: The primary browse-to-watch journey is obscured by stacked mandatory gates.
findings.evidence: Homepage, category and video screenshots all open under the consent modal while the age-verification call-to-action remains behind it.
findings.suggestedFix: Sequence consent and legally required age verification as one clear, recoverable flow before exposing the watch action.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP is outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.0 s and FCP 2.8 s (performance 0.81), despite the lighter local trace measuring LCP 1.02 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the true LCP resource, reduce render-blocking work, and verify under mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Load includes long main-thread tasks.
findings.evidence: Trace evidence found two long tasks, the longest 162.16 ms, with 123.44 ms total blocking time.
findings.suggestedFix: Break up long tasks and defer non-critical startup and modal code.

findings.summary: The critical network path is script-heavy and render-blocked.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 141 requests and 1.77 MB transferred, including 61 scripts/1.02 MB; Lighthouse estimated 1,160 ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce critical styles, defer non-critical scripts, and optimize LCP image discovery and cache lifetimes.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable unused and legacy code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 57 KiB unused CSS, 26 KiB unused JavaScript and 11 KiB legacy JavaScript; the largest script transferred 402 KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split route and modal bundles, remove unused CSS, and serve a modern bundle.

findings.summary: Interactive controls lack accessible names and labels.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name, link-name and label-content-name-mismatch; the local probe found an unlabeled input and unnamed button.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a semantic element and accessible name that matches its visible label.

findings.summary: Some text and controls fail minimum color contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast audit failed on the entry page.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA in normal and interactive states.

findings.summary: Focus and structural semantics are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed list semantics and the focus probe reported no visible outline on the first focusable link.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair list markup, preserve logical landmark/heading order, and add visible :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: The page blocks robust zoom/reflow and video alternatives.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and target-size; the video probe found six autoplay video elements with no caption tracks, and mobile overflow was 672 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user scaling, reflow at 320 CSS px, enlarge targets, and provide caption/equivalent tracks for meaningful video.

findings.summary: Many images lack intrinsic dimensions or are oversized.
findings.evidence: Image evidence found 29/36 images without width/height, 13 oversized images and 15 legacy-format assets; Lighthouse also failed unsized-images.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio and serve correctly sized responsive modern formats.

findings.summary: Crawler-friendly links are undermined by unnamed anchors and non-scalable viewport behavior.
findings.evidence: The metadata probe found 42 anchors without discernible text/name and Lighthouse failed meta-viewport, although robots allows key public routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Give all links descriptive accessible text and remove restrictive viewport scaling.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete/inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The audited host points canonical URLs at hil.xhamster.desi, has no hreflang links, and /sitemap.xml returned HTTP 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Confirm canonical consolidation is intentional, publish a sitemap, and expose hreflang for the many localized host variants.

findings.summary: Rich video pages lack structured and social metadata.
findings.evidence: The representative video probe found no JSON-LD, and the homepage metadata probe found no Open Graph properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Cookie and header defenses are incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS/CSP/HSTS are present, but headers evidence found no nosniff or Referrer-Policy; two of three cookies were not Secure and settings used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark HTTPS cookies Secure with an intentional SameSite policy and add nosniff plus a restrictive Referrer-Policy.

findings.summary: The entry load has a very broad third-party footprint before consent.
findings.evidence: HAR attributed 116/141 requests and 1.66/1.77 MB to third-party origins; tracker evidence enumerated 15 third-party origins while the consent modal was still open.
findings.suggestedFix: Block non-essential third-party loading until consent, audit every origin, and minimize/batch analytics.

findings.summary: Signup offers password/social identity but no phishing-resistant passkey path.
findings.evidence: The signup flow exposed Google, X and email/new-password options; no WebAuthn/passkey capability was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside recovery-safe fallbacks.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are only partially configured.
findings.evidence: CSP is limited to frame-ancestors; Referrer-Policy and nosniff are missing, and Permissions-Policy only covers two client hints.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a full CSP, nosniff, restrictive referrer/permissions policies, and retain clickjacking protection.

findings.summary: Overlay composition is fragile.
findings.evidence: Signup screenshot shows the signup dialog visually stacked behind the consent dialog, obscuring actions and context.
findings.suggestedFix: Serialize modal state, trap/restore focus correctly, and ensure only one modal top-layer surface is active.

findings.summary: Localization metadata and layout primitives are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The page declares lang=hil, but has no hreflang, no explicit dir, and stylesheet sampling found 705 physical left/right declarations versus 10 logical-property usages.
findings.suggestedFix: Add hreflang for localized variants, set direction deliberately, and migrate layout to inline/block logical properties.

findings.summary: The email signup form provides no actionable invalid-submission feedback.
findings.evidence: After opening email signup and submitting empty fields, fields had no required/aria-invalid state and no visible role=alert or aria-live error.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required constraints, validate after interaction, mark invalid fields, and announce concise recovery guidance.

findings.summary: Signup disables email autofill.
findings.evidence: The email signup probe found duplicate text inputs named email with autocomplete=off; only the password field used new-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Use type=email and autocomplete=email/username with one clear field; retain new-password for password creation.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes.
findings.evidence: Image evidence found 13 oversized images, 29 missing intrinsic dimensions, 15 legacy-format assets and 3 without responsive sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP sources at display-appropriate dimensions and reserve aspect ratios.

findings.summary: Startup fetch and script work is disproportionate to the initial task.
findings.evidence: The consent-covered page still transferred 1.77 MB across 141 requests, including 61 scripts and two long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer background, personalization and promotional work until needed and after consent.

findings.summary: Third-party and autoplay media cost is excessive.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 1.66 MB; the video template exposed six autoplay video elements with no native controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Load one user-initiated primary player, pause offscreen previews, and enforce a third-party/media budget.

findings.summary: The initial memory footprint is heavy for a consent-covered listing.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap contained 687,114 nodes and 36.76 MB self size; after ten menu toggles it held 730,452 nodes and 39.21 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce retained component/script state and lazy-load below-fold UI; profile constructor growth in a same-session baseline/target/final workflow.

taskList.title: Rebuild the 360 px layout and restore zoom/focus accessibility
Sequence consent and age verification as one semantic, non-stacking flow
Repair names, labels, contrast, lists and signup errors
Cut startup scripts, render blocking, third-party fetches and media autoplay
Harden cookies, CSP and response policies
Fix image sizing and responsive delivery
Complete canonical, sitemap, hreflang and rich-video metadata
Profile and reduce the retained heap footprint
Add restrained route and scroll-state navigation cues
